name: BFAI
summary: BFAI, also known as 5,6-benzofuranyl-2-aminoindane, is a drug of the 2-aminoindane family that was developed to act as a selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA) and may produce entactogenic effects in humans, with potential psychotherapeutic applications. It is closely related to MDAI but with the benzodioxole ring system replaced by a benzofuran ring. The drug was patented by Matthew Baggott and Tactogen in 2022.

pharmacology.text: BFAI, also known as 5,6-benzofuranyl-2-aminoindane, is a drug of the 2-aminoindane family that was developed to act as a selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA) and may produce entactogenic effects in humans, with potential psychotherapeutic applications.

uses.en: It is a research compound, designed to release serotonin selectively and studied as a possible entactogen. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，設計上選擇性地釋放血清素，並作為可能的同感劑被研究，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，设计上选择性地释放血清素，并作为可能的同感剂被研究，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It belongs to the 2-aminoindanes, where the flexible side chain of an amphetamine is locked into a five membered ring. That rigid shape is what steers it towards serotonin alone.
fact.zh: 它屬於 2-胺基茚類，也就是把安非他命柔軟的側鏈鎖進一個五員環中。正是這種剛硬的形狀讓它專一地指向血清素。
fact.zhHans: 它属于 2-胺基茚类，也就是把安非他命柔软的侧链锁进一个五员环中。正是这种刚硬的形状让它专一地指向血清素。
